title: Load every van right
brief: I assign regional freight by memory each morning and only discover an overloaded van when the driver calls back.

target_population.role: dispatcher pairing twelve fictional shipments with five drivers each morning
target_population.coverage_limit: one depot's morning run; no routing, tracking, or customer contact

core_task.summary: assign a heavy shipment to a driver and confirm the capacity bar updates
core_task.success_oracle: assigning the 950 kg shipment S-108 to Nadia's 1200 kg van fills her capacity bar to 950, and any assignment that would exceed a van's capacity is refused with an overload warning

not_applicable_states.loading: shipments and vans are seeded local records and load math is immediate arithmetic, so the board never shows an in-flight assignment

state_recipes.empty: assign all twelve seeded shipments; the unassigned queue collapses to its depot-clear message
state_recipes.validation-error: assign the 400 kg shipment S-104 to Nadia after S-108; the overload warning names the 150 kg excess and refuses
state_recipes.success: assign S-108 to Nadia; her capacity bar reads 950 of 1200 kg
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the first unassigned shipment's driver picker shows its focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the board at 390x844; driver columns become a horizontal capacity strip above the queue

acceptance_facts: The seed defines twelve shipments totalling 6.4 tonnes and five drivers with van capacities from 800 to 1500 kg.
Assigning shipment S-108 to Nadia shows 950 of 1200 kg used on her capacity bar.
An assignment that would exceed a van's capacity is refused with a warning naming the overload amount.

product_signature.mechanism: per-van capacity bars that fill as shipments land on each driver
product_signature.anchor: driver columns with capacity bars across the board
product_signature.brief_trace: only discover an overloaded van when the driver calls back
product_signature.counterfactual: a plain assignment list would fit a task-board brief and cannot show remaining payload per van
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows Nadia's bar at 950 of 1200 kg with S-108 pinned to her column

anti_goals: no GPS, maps, or route optimization
no real carrier, customer, or address data
no driver messaging or notification flows

content_seed.data_notes: twelve invented shipments and five invented drivers; S-108 plus S-104 on Nadia's van deliberately exceeds 1200 kg to fix the refusal case
